title: What changed in prediction markets
insights:
- **Kalshi’s parlay share stayed near its recent norm as volume eased:** On Nov. 24, it traded 3.49B contracts, 11% below its seven-day average of 3.94B; parlays accounted for 2.37B, versus a 30-day daily average of 2.71B, and 67.7% of volume versus a 68.4% average share.
- **OG/Crypto.com gained ground as Polymarket US slowed:** OG/Crypto.com traded 128.3M contracts on Nov. 24, 23% above its 30-day average and about 2.9% of the market; Polymarket US traded 466.6M, 15% below its average, at about 10.4% of the market.
- **Underdog traded well below its recent pace:** Its 83.9M contracts on Nov. 24 were 26% below its 30-day average of 112.9M, representing about 1.9% of the market.

evidence.label: Additional context 1
evidence.sql:
WITH venue_daily AS (
    SELECT 'Kalshi' AS venue, date AS report_date, contracts_total AS contracts
    FROM daily_overall
    WHERE is_partial IS NOT TRUE AND date <= DATE '2026-11-24'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT CASE platform
               WHEN 'Polymarket_US' THEN 'Polymarket US'
               WHEN 'Crypto.com/Nadex' THEN 'OG/Crypto.com'
               ELSE platform
           END,
           date,
           contracts
    FROM competitor_daily
    WHERE platform IN ('Polymarket_US', 'ForecastEx', 'DKeX', 'Underdog Exchange',
                       'Crypto.com/Nadex', 'Novig', 'Rothera')
      AND COALESCE(complete, TRUE)
      AND date <= DATE '2026-11-24'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'ProphetX', date, contracts
    FROM prophetx_daily
    WHERE COALESCE(complete, TRUE) AND date <= DATE '2026-11-24'
),
latest_dates AS (
    SELECT venue, MAX(report_date) AS latest_date
    FROM venue_daily
    GROUP BY venue
),
latest AS (
    SELECT v.venue, l.latest_date, v.contracts AS latest_contracts
    FROM venue_daily v
    JOIN latest_dates l
      ON v.venue = l.venue AND v.report_date = l.latest_date
),
prior_30d AS (
    SELECT l.venue, AVG(v.contracts) AS prior_30d_avg
    FROM latest_dates l
    JOIN venue_daily v
      ON v.venue = l.venue
     AND v.report_date >= l.latest_date - INTERVAL 30 DAY
     AND v.report_date < l.latest_date
    GROUP BY l.venue
)
SELECT l.venue, l.latest_date, l.latest_contracts, p.prior_30d_avg,
       (l.latest_contracts - p.prior_30d_avg) / NULLIF(p.prior_30d_avg, 0) * 100
           AS pct_change_vs_prior_30d_average
FROM latest l
LEFT JOIN prior_30d p USING (venue)
ORDER BY pct_change_vs_prior_30d_average DESC;

evidence.label: Additional context 2
evidence.sql:
WITH latest_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(date) AS date
    FROM category_daily
    WHERE date <= DATE '2026-11-24'
),
daily_categories AS (
    SELECT c.kalshi_category,
           c.contracts AS latest_contracts,
           c.fees AS latest_fees,
           SUM(p.contracts) / 30.0 AS prior_30d_avg_contracts
    FROM category_daily c
    CROSS JOIN latest_date d
    LEFT JOIN category_daily p
      ON p.kalshi_category = c.kalshi_category
     AND p.date >= d.date - INTERVAL 30 DAY
     AND p.date < d.date
    WHERE c.date = d.date
    GROUP BY c.kalshi_category, c.contracts, c.fees
),
day_total AS (
    SELECT d.date, o.contracts_total
    FROM latest_date d
    JOIN daily_overall o USING (date)
)
SELECT c.kalshi_category, c.latest_contracts, c.prior_30d_avg_contracts,
       (c.latest_contracts - c.prior_30d_avg_contracts)
           / NULLIF(c.prior_30d_avg_contracts, 0) * 100 AS pct_change_vs_prior_30d_average,
       c.latest_contracts * 100.0 / NULLIF(t.contracts_total, 0) AS share_of_kalshi_volume_pct,
       c.latest_fees
FROM daily_categories c
CROSS JOIN day_total t
ORDER BY c.latest_contracts DESC
LIMIT 12;

evidence.label: Additional context 3
evidence.sql:
WITH latest_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(date) AS date
    FROM daily_sports_vs_nonsports
    WHERE date <= DATE '2026-11-24'
),
current_mix AS (
    SELECT d.date,
           d.contracts_sports_nonparlay,
           d.contracts_nonsports,
           d.contracts_parlay,
           d.share_sports_nonparlay,
           d.share_nonsports,
           d.share_parlay
    FROM daily_sports_vs_nonsports d
    JOIN latest_date l USING (date)
),
prior_30d AS (
    SELECT SUM(d.contracts_sports_nonparlay) / 30.0 AS avg_sports_nonparlay,
           SUM(d.contracts_nonsports) / 30.0 AS avg_nonsports,
           SUM(d.contracts_parlay) / 30.0 AS avg_parlay,
           AVG(d.share_sports_nonparlay) AS avg_share_sports_nonparlay,
           AVG(d.share_nonsports) AS avg_share_nonsports,
           AVG(d.share_parlay) AS avg_share_parlay
    FROM daily_sports_vs_nonsports d
    CROSS JOIN latest_date l
    WHERE d.date >= l.date - INTERVAL 30 DAY
      AND d.date < l.date
)
SELECT c.date,
       c.contracts_sports_nonparlay,
       p.avg_sports_nonparlay,
       c.contracts_nonsports,
       p.avg_nonsports,
       c.contracts_parlay,
       p.avg_parlay,
       c.share_sports_nonparlay,
       p.avg_share_sports_nonparlay,
       c.share_nonsports,
       p.avg_share_nonsports,
       c.share_parlay,
       p.avg_share_parlay
FROM current_mix c
CROSS JOIN prior_30d p;

anchor.question: Build the anchor table for today's Predict Charts industry briefing. For each prediction-market venue, use its latest complete reported day and return venue, report date, reported contract volume, the average of its prior seven complete reported days, and percent change versus that average. Use daily_overall for Kalshi and exclude rows where is_partial is true. Use competitor_daily only for platforms other than Kalshi, add ProphetX from prophetx_daily, and add CME from cme_daily. Never use competitor_daily's Kalshi row; it is not the authoritative Kalshi total. In competitor_daily the `complete` column is only populated for Polymarket_US and is NULL for every other platform, where NULL means the row IS complete. Filter it as COALESCE(complete, TRUE) or omit the filter entirely; never write `complete = TRUE`, which silently discards every platform whose flag is NULL. Exclude partial days. CME is the sparse bulletin series; a normal seven-day lookback spanning seven calendar days is regular, not sparse. Resolve the latest complete reported day SEPARATELY FOR EACH VENUE. Do not filter the whole result to one shared calendar date, and do not require a venue to have a row on the newest date any venue reported: a venue whose most recent complete day is a few days old is reporting normally and still belongs in the table, on its own date. Each venue's prior-seven-day baseline is its own prior seven REPORTED days, which for an irregular reporter spans more than seven calendar days. Every one of these ten venues must appear in the result: Kalshi, Polymarket US, ForecastEx, DKeX, Underdog Exchange, OG/Crypto.com, ProphetX, Novig, Rothera, CME. OG/Crypto.com is the platform stored as 'Crypto.com/Nadex'.
anchor.sql:
WITH venue_daily AS (
    SELECT
        'Kalshi' AS venue,
        date AS report_date,
        contracts_total AS contract_volume
    FROM daily_overall
    WHERE is_partial IS NOT TRUE

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        CASE platform
            WHEN 'Polymarket_US' THEN 'Polymarket US'
            WHEN 'Crypto.com/Nadex' THEN 'OG/Crypto.com'
            ELSE platform
        END AS venue,
        date AS report_date,
        contracts AS contract_volume
    FROM competitor_daily
    WHERE platform IN (
        'Polymarket_US',
        'ForecastEx',
        'DKeX',
        'Underdog Exchange',
        'Crypto.com/Nadex',
        'Novig',
        'Rothera'
    )
      AND COALESCE(complete, TRUE)

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'ProphetX' AS venue,
        date AS report_date,
        contracts AS contract_volume
    FROM prophetx_daily
    WHERE COALESCE(complete, TRUE)

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'CME' AS venue,
        date AS report_date,
        cme_total_vol AS contract_volume
    FROM cme_daily
),
with_baselines AS (
    SELECT
        venue,
        report_date,
        contract_volume,
        AVG(contract_volume) OVER (
            PARTITION BY venue
            ORDER BY report_date
            ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
        ) AS prior_seven_day_average,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY venue
            ORDER BY report_date DESC
        ) AS latest_rank
    FROM venue_daily
)
SELECT
    venue,
    report_date,
    contract_volume AS reported_contract_volume,
    prior_seven_day_average,
    (contract_volume - prior_seven_day_average)
        / NULLIF(prior_seven_day_average, 0) * 100 AS percent_change_vs_prior_seven_days
FROM with_baselines
WHERE latest_rank = 1
ORDER BY venue;
